title: refactor(runbook-autodiagnostics): add conditional checks and plugin hooks for extensible diagnostics
author: Asha Kapoor
body: Motivation: runbook autodiagnostics has grown organically and contains a number of special-case checks embedded in the core handler. This makes adding new diagnostics (for SLOs or infrastructure signals) slow and error-prone. This PR refactors the autodiagnostics pipeline to introduce a stable plugin hook API and a lightweight conditional-check DSL, so teams can add new runbook checks without touching core logic. The change is implemented behind a feature flag (autodiag.refactor_enabled) and is backwards-compatible by default. Implementation summary: 1) extract existing diagnostic checks into first-party plugins; 2) implement a plugin registry with lifecycle hooks (Init, Run, Teardown); 3) add a conditional-check DSL (YAML) with operators for threshold, absence/presence, and sample-rate gating; 4) migrate two heavyweight checks (prefix cache pressure and gpu-scheduling-backlog) to plugins; 5) add unit and integration tests and update docs and runbook templates. Checklist: - [x] design review (ENG-4721) - [x] unit tests - [x] integration tests with incident-bot e2e harness - [x] migration guide + docs - [x] feature-flag gated rollout and telemetry - [x] canary on staging then prod Rollout plan: enable feature flag in staging for 48h with increased sampling, monitor SLO-toolkit alerts and oncall feedback, then enable gradual rollout to 20% of production traffic, observe for 72h, then full rollout. Backwards compatibility: configuration supports a legacy-mode mapping so existing YAML runbooks continue to function. Observability: added metrics for plugin run latency, plugin error counts, and conditional-evaluation counts. Related: ENG-4725 adds two new runbook templates that consume the conditional DSL. Links: design doc: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-4721/runbook-autodiagnostics-refactor, rollout checklist: internal runbooks/incident-bot/autodiag-rollout.

review_comments: Jonah: Nice cleanup. Two concerns: 1) plugin panic isolation, 2) overhead of DSL evaluation on hot paths. Please add a sandbox for plugins and memoize condition results per-request.
Author (Asha): Added plugin panic isolation using recover() in registry.RunWithTimeout and added request-scoped memoization cache for DSL results. See commit b2f7d9a.
Liang: Can we add a version key to plugins so we can do Gradual Rollouts of plugin behavior?
Author: Added 'plugin_version' metadata and included it in the registry for telemetry and graceful upgrade paths.
Sofia: Integration tests look good, but please add a smoke test verifying legacy mode remains identical for existing runbooks.
Author: Added legacy_adapter_test and end-to-end smoke test.
ci_checks: CI: integration/e2e - failed on first run (flaky fixture), reran -> passed
release_notes: Refactor: runbook autodiagnostics extracted into a plugin-driven system with a conditional-check DSL. Backwards-compatible by default. Adds metrics for plugin latency and errors. See docs/runbooks/autodiag.md for migration steps.
